title.text: Dubai: Half-Day City Sightseeing, Souks & Abra Experience

pills.label: 5 hours, 11 stops
pills.pop_html: Route: Burj Al Arab photo stop (15 min), drive past Atlantis The Palm and Atlantis The Royal, Dubai Marina walk (15 min), Museum of the Future (15 min), Blue Mosque (30 min), Gold and Spice Souks (30 min each), Dubai Creek, abra ride (15 min), Al Fahidi (30 min) and Al Khayma Heritage House (30 min).

pills.label: Blue Mosque inside
pills.pop_html: Entries: A 30-minute guided visit of the Al Farooq Omar Bin Al Khattab (Blue) Mosque and access to the Museum of the Future ground floor. The only tour here under €30 that takes you inside a mosque.

pills.label: Hotel pickup
pills.pop_html: Transport: Hotel pickup and drop-off in an air-conditioned vehicle, plus the 15-minute abra crossing of Dubai Creek. No bus timetables to work around.

pills.label: 5 languages
pills.pop_html: Guide: Licensed live guide in English, Italian, German, French or Spanish. Shared small group by default, with a private option at checkout.

best_for.pick_html: for a first-timer with one free morning or afternoon, because €24.48 buys 5 guided hours, pickup, an abra ride and a mosque visit, which is less than any bus pass on this page
best_for.skip_html: if you want Burj Khalifa or Dubai Mall in the same tour; neither is on this route

items.a: Air-conditioned vehicle, licensed guide, Dubai Marina walk, Blue Mosque visit, Museum of the Future ground floor, abra ride.
Free up to 24 hours before.
Hotel pickup and drop-off in Dubai.
Shared small group, private option available.
English, Italian, German, French, Spanish.

kicker.map: 📍 Any Red or Blue Route stop

pills.label: 24h, 48h or 5 days
pills.pop_html: Tickets: 24 hours is bus only. 48 hours adds entry to The Lost Chambers Aquarium at Atlantis. The 5-day (120-hour) ticket adds the aquarium and the Dubai Frame.

pills.label: Red + Blue Routes
pills.pop_html: Stops: Red Route: Wafi Mall, Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall, Museum of the Future, Arabian Dhow Cruise, Bastakiya, Old Souk, Gold and Spice Souk, Dubai Frame. Blue Route: Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall, Souk Madinat Jumeirah/Burj Al Arab, Atlantis The Palm.

pills.label: Audio in 6 languages
pills.pop_html: Commentary: Recorded commentary in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian and Russian. Headphones included. No live guide.

pills.label: Wheelchair-accessible
pills.pop_html: Access: Open-top double-decker buses that are wheelchair-accessible. Of the car and van tours on this page, only the VIP private tour says the same.

best_for.pick_html: for 2–5 day stays and families who want to stop where they like, because the 48-hour ticket bundles Lost Chambers Aquarium entry and the bus links Bastakiya, Dubai Mall and Atlantis
best_for.skip_html: if you only have one day and hate waiting in the heat; a €24 guided tour covers more with pickup

items.a: 24-, 48- or 120-hour ticket, Red and Blue Routes, audio commentary with headphones; Lost Chambers Aquarium (48h and 5-day), Dubai Frame (5-day).
Free up to 24 hours before.
Wheelchair-accessible.
From €37 per person (24-hour ticket). The final price for your date is shown before you pay.
English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Russian (audio).

title.text: Dubai: VIP Private City Tour with Burj Khalifa Entry Tickets

pills.label: Burj Khalifa 124–125
pills.pop_html: Entry: Skip-the-ticket-line entry to levels 124–125 with about 1 hour at the top and sunset views from the deck. The only tour here with a Burj Khalifa ticket included.

pills.label: Private car + guide
pills.pop_html: Format: Private group only, luxury private vehicle and a licensed guide in Arabic, English, French or German.

pills.label: Pro photos
pills.pop_html: Extra: The guide photographs you along the way with a professional camera, and the photos are free.

pills.label: Ends at the fountains
pills.pop_html: Route: Dubai Mall and Aquarium photo stop, Burj Khalifa, Al Fahidi, abra crossing, Gold and Spice Souks, Sheikh Zayed Road, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, Burj Al Arab, Blue Mosque, then the Dubai Fountain.

best_for.pick_html: for couples or a small group with one day who want Burj Khalifa, old Dubai and the Dubai Fountain in a single private booking, because the €136.69 already includes the observation deck ticket
best_for.skip_html: if you already hold Burj Khalifa tickets or want a short morning tour; you are paying for the deck and a full day

items.a: Private guide, private luxury vehicle, Burj Khalifa levels 124–125 skip-the-line entry, abra crossing, professional photos.
Free up to 24 hours before.
Hotel pickup in Dubai.
Private group.
Arabic, English, French, German.

title.text: Dubai: Half-Day City Tour of Old & New Dubai with Abra Ride

pills.label: 4 hours
pills.pop_html: Timing: Choose a morning or afternoon departure at checkout. Route: Gold Souk and Spice Souk (30 min each), Al Fahidi, abra ride (20 min), Museum of the Future, Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, Burj Khalifa.

pills.label: 20-min abra
pills.pop_html: Old Dubai: A traditional wooden abra across Dubai Creek, the longest abra slot of the guided tours here, plus the wind-tower lanes of Al Fahidi (Bastakiya).

pills.label: Burj Khalifa photo stop
pills.pop_html: New Dubai: Photo stops at the Museum of the Future, Burj Al Arab and Atlantis The Palm, a scenic drive through Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah, and 20 minutes at Burj Khalifa. Entry tickets not included.

pills.label: Pickup + water
pills.pop_html: Included: Hotel pickup and drop-off, licensed English-speaking guide and chilled bottled water. Private or small-group options.

best_for.pick_html: for travellers who want old and new Dubai in 4 hours and a free afternoon (or morning), because it costs €24.69 and adds a Burj Khalifa stop that #1 skips
best_for.skip_html: if you need a guide in a language other than English, or want to go inside a mosque

items.a: Licensed English-speaking guide, abra ride, Spice and Gold Souks, Al Fahidi, photo stops, bottled water.
Entry tickets (Burj Khalifa, Museum of the Future exhibits), food, meals, soft drinks.
Free up to 24 hours before.
Hotel pickup and drop-off in Dubai.
English.

title.text: Dubai: City Tour with Professional Guide in a Luxury Car

pills.label: Luxury car
pills.pop_html: Transport: Air-conditioned luxury car with pickup and drop-off from your accommodation. Details are confirmed by WhatsApp or email before the tour.

pills.label: Jumeirah Mosque
pills.pop_html: Unique stops: The only tour here with a Jumeirah Mosque photo stop, plus Dubai Frame photo stop, Al Seef and an optional stop at Zabeel Palace.

pills.label: 14 stops, 5 hours
pills.pop_html: Route: Spice and Gold Souks, Dubai Creek, Al Seef, Dubai Frame, Jumeirah Mosque, Jumeirah Beach, Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah and Atlantis drive, Dubai Marina, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa photo stop, Zabeel Palace.

pills.label: 5-min pickup rule
pills.pop_html: Catch: Be in the lobby 20 minutes before pickup; the driver waits no longer than 5 minutes, then you count as a no-show. Burj Khalifa and Dubai Museum tickets not included.

best_for.pick_html: for travellers who want a more comfortable car and the widest stop list, including Jumeirah Mosque, Dubai Frame and Dubai Mall, because no other guided tour here covers all three
best_for.skip_html: if you want an abra ride or a private car; the abra is not listed and the pickup rules say the guide collects other guests

items.a: Luxury car, guide, souks, Dubai Creek, Dubai Frame, Jumeirah Mosque and Burj Al Arab photo stops, Dubai Mall.
Burj Khalifa and Dubai Museum tickets, tips, airport parking.
Free up to 24 hours before.
Pickup and drop-off from your accommodation; wait in the lobby 20 minutes before.
English.

title.text: Dubai: Nighttime Guided City Tour by Van & DXB Fountain Show

pills.label: 4 hours after dark
pills.pop_html: Route: Burj Khalifa lit up, Burj Al Arab against the night sky, a waterfront walk on Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, then the Dubai Fountain show at the base of Burj Khalifa.

pills.label: Fountain show
pills.pop_html: Finale: The Dubai Fountain water and light show is included and ends the tour at Dubai Mall, so you can stay for dinner or shopping.

pills.label: Group or private
pills.pop_html: Options: Group option: hotel pickup, drop-off at Dubai Mall and you get back on your own. Private option: hotel pickup and hotel drop-off.

pills.label: 8 languages
pills.pop_html: Guide: Live guide in English, Italian, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Russian or Arabic. Food and drinks not included.

best_for.pick_html: for night owls and anyone who spent the day at the beach or in the desert, because €28.40 gets you lit-up new Dubai plus the fountain show with pickup
best_for.skip_html: if you want old Dubai or the souks; this route is new Dubai only

items.a: Guide, night city tour by van, Dubai Fountain show.
Food and drinks.
Free up to 24 hours before.
Hotel pickup; hotel drop-off on the private option, Dubai Mall drop-off on the group option.
English, Italian, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic.

title.text: City Sightseeing Hop-on Hop-off Bus + Sunset and Night Tour

pills.label: Sunset + Night Tour
pills.pop_html: Extra: Adds a Sunset and Night Tour to the two daytime routes, the only bus pass here that covers the city after dark.

pills.label: 11 languages
pills.pop_html: Audio: Recorded commentary in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian and Arabic, the widest choice on this page.

pills.label: Red + Blue Routes
pills.pop_html: Stops: Red Route: Museum of the Future and Al Seef heritage area. Blue Route: Palm Jumeirah and Mall of the Emirates. Other named sights: Burj Khalifa, Old Souk, Atlantis and Dubai Marina Mall.

pills.label: Check stops first
pills.pop_html: Catch: Recorded audio only and no hotel pickup, and the 24-hour ticket costs €6.53 more than Big Bus. Check current stops and frequency before buying.

best_for.pick_html: for travellers who want a bus pass and a night loop in one ticket, or need commentary in Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Portuguese or Arabic
best_for.skip_html: if you want the old town on your schedule; Big Bus (#2) is cheaper and lists the souk stops

items.a: 24- or 48-hour hop-on hop-off ticket, Red and Blue Routes, Sunset and Night Tour, audio commentary.
Free up to 24 hours before.
